authority: Independent experimental definitions; synthetic cases only; no official TEI or universal ontology claim.

input_shape.suite: Object with format_version: 1 and nonempty cases array. Each case has a unique nonempty id, description, model, expected and optional reanchor.
input_shape.model: Exactly texts, versions, regions, annotations; each is an array of objects. IDs are nonempty strings and globally unique.

version.sha256: lowercase SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes
version.parent: optional existing version ID of same text; null is invalid

A.end: exclusive integer offset; 0 <= start < end <= length

B.prefix: optional immediately adjacent literal Unicode string
B.suffix: optional immediately adjacent literal Unicode string

reanchor.target_version: explicit destination version ID belonging to same text

input_shape.expected: Exact object: diagnostics (sorted unique codes), resolutions (region ID -> {version,start,end,quote}), optional reanchor ({diagnostics,proposal}).

semantics.normalization: None. UTF-8 encodability required; code points, not grapheme clusters or UTF-16 units.
semantics.unknown_fields: Model and model objects/selectors reject unknown fields. Descriptive suite/case fields are not semantically evaluated.
semantics.ancestry: At most one parent of the same text; iterative cycle detection.
semantics.failure: Structural identity/reference/hash/cycle errors suppress all resolutions. Selector errors suppress only the affected region.
semantics.quotation: Literal case-sensitive occurrence search includes overlapping matches. Empty quotes/regions excluded.
semantics.reanchor: Model must fully validate; retain A quote or B quote and context, search target, return all candidates and absent/unique/ambiguous status. accepted is always false; original objects never mutate.
semantics.expectation: Case checks compare the exact diagnostics-code set and resolutions/proposals to hand-authored expected values. Diagnostic paths appear in the report for inspection.
semantics.report: Deterministic UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, no timestamps or absolute paths; SHA-256 of contract, spec, cases and imported project implementation modules. Runner exits nonzero on any expectation mismatch or --check drift.

diagnostics.E_ID: Object ID is not a nonempty string.
diagnostics.E_DUPLICATE_ID: An ID occurs more than once across model objects.
diagnostics.E_REFERENCE: A required typed reference does not resolve to the intended object category.
diagnostics.E_OWNERSHIP: Version parent belongs to another text.
diagnostics.E_HASH: Version content differs from declared SHA-256 or hash field is malformed.
diagnostics.E_SELECTOR: Unknown/malformed selector, empty quote, or invalid Unicode/context.
diagnostics.E_BOUNDS: A positions are not integer nonempty bounds inside the version.
diagnostics.E_QUOTE: A's selected substring differs from its integrity quote.
diagnostics.E_NO_MATCH: B has no matching quote/context occurrence.
diagnostics.E_AMBIGUOUS: B has multiple matching quote/context occurrences.
diagnostics.E_REANCHOR: Malformed request, invalid source model/region, missing target, or cross-text target.

limitations: No P5 conversion, discontinuous/empty regions, collaborative editing, grapheme indexing, normalization, or automatic interpretation transfer.
Finite synthetic fixtures cannot demonstrate philosophical correctness, real-world migration cost, or annotation usability.
